prompt: A note slides under your office door: your accountant has been skimming from the company for years. No one else has seen it yet.

choiceLeft.label: Report it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You did the right thing. It cost you a friend.

choiceRight.label: Look away
choiceRight.consequenceText: You told yourself it wasn't your problem.

prompt: A man outside the station asks for anything you can spare. You recognize him from last week.

choiceLeft.label: Give what you have
choiceLeft.consequenceText: He thanks you like you're the first person who has all month.

prompt: Your grandmother's ring would cover next month's rent twice over. A dealer downtown is offering cash today, no questions.

choiceLeft.label: Sell it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your mother notices it's gone before you've spent the money.

choiceRight.label: Keep it
choiceRight.consequenceText: You'll figure the rent out some other way.

prompt: An old friend calls, asking to borrow money you both know they won't pay back on time, if ever.

choiceLeft.label: Help them
choiceLeft.consequenceText: They sound relieved enough that you almost forget to worry about it.

choiceRight.label: Turn them down
choiceRight.consequenceText: The call ends shorter than it started.

prompt: You have information that would ruin a competitor if it reached a reporter. It would also make your quarter.

choiceLeft.label: Leak it
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It runs the next morning. Nobody can prove it was you.

choiceRight.label: Stay silent
choiceRight.consequenceText: You let the quarter be what it is.

prompt: The deadline is in six hours and the numbers still don't work. You could push through the night, again.

choiceLeft.label: Push through the night
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You make it. You don't remember most of how.

choiceRight.label: Walk away from the deadline
choiceRight.consequenceText: You sleep. The deadline is someone else's problem now.

prompt: Your biggest rival offers you a way past your competitor, quietly, for a price you can't put in writing.

choiceLeft.label: Take the deal
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You shake on it. You already know this isn't the end of it.

prompt: Months later, your rival calls in what you owe them — and it's not money they want this time.

choiceLeft.label: Pay what they ask
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You pay it. Someone you trusted finds out why.

choiceRight.label: Refuse and cut ties
choiceRight.consequenceText: You refuse. You spend the next weeks waiting to see what that costs you.

prompt: Your sibling, who hasn't spoken to you in three years, texts asking if you're free this weekend.

choiceLeft.label: Reach out
choiceLeft.consequenceText: It's awkward for the first hour. Then it isn't.

choiceRight.label: Let it go
choiceRight.consequenceText: You leave it on read. It's easier this way, you tell yourself.

prompt: You've had a standing appointment on your calendar for two weeks. Something else has come up, again.

choiceLeft.label: Go
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You almost cancelled. You're glad you didn't.

prompt: A gala invitation arrives with your name on the donor wall — if you write the check by Friday.

choiceLeft.label: Donate publicly
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Your name goes up on the wall. People you haven't spoken to in years congratulate you.

choiceRight.label: Skip it
choiceRight.consequenceText: You keep the money and decline the invitation.

prompt: It's late, you're alone, and the thing you swore you'd stopped doing is one decision away again.

choiceLeft.label: Give in
choiceLeft.consequenceText: Just this once, you tell yourself. Again.

choiceRight.label: Resist
choiceRight.consequenceText: You put the phone down. It doesn't feel like relief.

prompt: You've found proof your business partner has been lying to your biggest client for months.

choiceLeft.label: Expose them
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The client leaves. So, eventually, does your partner.

choiceRight.label: Cover for them
choiceRight.consequenceText: The lie gets bigger, and now it's yours too.

prompt: Your father's will is being contested by a sibling who says you influenced him at the end.

choiceLeft.label: Fight for your share
choiceLeft.consequenceText: You win. You also stop getting invited to family things.

choiceRight.label: Walk away
choiceRight.consequenceText: You let it go. It's not the money you wanted to keep.

prompt: There's a way to close the deal tonight that skips every safeguard your company has. No one would ever trace it back.

choiceLeft.label: Take the shortcut
choiceLeft.consequenceText: The deal closes. You keep checking your inbox for weeks.

choiceRight.label: Do it the hard way
choiceRight.consequenceText: It takes three more weeks. You sleep fine.
